RSS and GDELT, Signal) in a window counted towards the tile. The counts now come from the
sheet's verified M&A deals only (12 months). These feed deals are not counted any more and
are shown on the tile as "Unverified deal signals (feed)".

For the owner to verify and, where real, add to the sheet's T2 M&A tab. The feed gives no
target name or value; the headline is shown. The 'Counted in' column says which count it
changed (12 months or 5 years, and the category).
